text: Students must maintain at least 75 percent attendance in each course.
Students with attendance below 75 percent may be prevented from taking the final examination.
Students should submit assignments before the deadline given by the instructor.
Late assignments may receive reduced marks according to the course policy.
Students must bring their university identification card when entering an examination hall.
Mobile phones and other electronic devices are not allowed during examinations.
Students can borrow books from the university library using their valid student card.
Library books should be returned on or before the specified due date.
Students should contact the course instructor when they have questions about course requirements.
The university provides online learning resources through its student portal.
